up: List all molecules reported in the document with chembl_id 'CHEMBL1614632'. For each molecule, provide the following columns: molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort the results by the molecule_chembl_id in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614632' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
